text: On the Keeper's Island, the lamp has turned every night for a hundred years.
asr: On the Keeper's Island, the lamp has turned every night for a hundred years.

text: Gus has kept it for thirty of them. He has never once missed a turn.
Tonight, at twelve minutes past three…
Twelve seconds of dark. Then the lamp came back by itself.
Out at sea, a horn answered. Something had been sailing toward the light.
